prompt: Who was the youngest climber to podium at the first year climbing was in the olympics?
answer: Alberto Ginés López of Spain was the youngest climber to podium at climbing’s Olympic debut in Tokyo 2020. He was 18 when he won the men’s combined gold medal. (Colin Duffy was younger at 17, but finished seventh and did not podium.)
